video_title: If You Give A Mouse A Cookie, If You Give A Dog A Donut and If You Give A Pig A Pancake | A TRILOGY
description:
The #1 New York Times bestselling If You Give a Mouse a Cookie and If You Take a Mouse to School are available in a board book set.

In the circle story If You Give a Mouse a Cookie, a little mouse runs a small boy ragged as he demands one thing after another when the boy offers him a cookie. The same boy and mouse are back in If You Take a Mouse to School, where boy and mouse learn about science, math, reading, writing, skateboarding, and basketball during their day at school.

These board book editions with sturdy pages are perfect for preschoolers, who will enjoy the simple introduction to Mouse's adventures.
If you give a pig a pancake, she'll want some syrup to go with it. You'll give her some of your favorite maple syrup, and she'll probably get all sticky, so she'll want to take a bath. She'll ask you for some bubbles. When you give her the bubbles...
If you give a dog a donut, he’ll ask for some apple juice to go with it. When you give him the juice, he’ll drink it all up. Then, before you can say “woof” . . . Dog is off on a backyard adventure!

Written in the tradition of the bestselling If You Give a Mouse a Cookie, Laura Numeroff and Felicia Bond's If You Give a Dog a Donut is another winner.

The If You Give... series is a perennial favorite among children. With its spare, rhythmic text and circular tale, these books are perfect for beginning readers and story time. Sure to inspire giggles and requests to "read it again!"

Readers will delight in the story of an accommodating little girl who tries to keep up with the whims of a busy little pig.

Fans of If You Give a Mouse a Cookie will love this perfect addition to the series!

The If You Give... series is a perennial favorite among children. With its spare, rhythmic text and circular tale, these books are perfect for beginning readers and story time. Sure to inspire giggles and requests to "read it again!"

story_title: There Is An Alligator Under My Bed
author: Mercer Mayer
video_title: There Is An Alligator Under My Bed | ANIMATED STORYBOOK - Written And Illustrated by Mercer Mayer
description:
What would you do if you knew there was an alligator under your bed? You could try to tell your parents but you know they would never be able to see it. It's going to be up to you or in this case up to that courageous little fellow who conquered the nightmare in There's a Nightmare in My Closet. This time he has more tricks up his pajama sleeve. This story approaches the nighttime fears yet again but with a lighter tone and a sense of fun.

How will our valiant hero lure the alligator out and get rid of him for once and for all? The alligator is monstrously large and green and definitely adds that ferocious quality of fear to the story but he's smiling as he makes his way through the house. The ending leads to a whole different story possibility but we'll just leave that to your imagination.

video_title: Creepy Carrots! by Aaron Reynolds | ANIMATED STORYBOOK
description:
#animatedstorybook #5minswithuncleben #creepycarrots 
In this Caldecott Honor–winning picture book, The Twilight Zone comes to the carrot patch as a rabbit fears his favorite treats are out to get him.

Jasper Rabbit loves carrots—especially Crackenhopper Field carrots.
He eats them on the way to school.
He eats them going to Little League.
He eats them walking home.
Until the day the carrots start following him...or are they?
     Celebrated artist Peter Brown’s stylish illustrations pair perfectly with Aaron Reynold’s text in this hilarious picture book that shows it’s all fun and games…until you get too greedy.
